gbm_population_evidence.quote: histologically proven high-grade glioma including GBM, anaplastic astrocytoma (AA), anaplastic oligodendroglioma (AO)

candidate_evidence.quote: Patients will receive 5-Aminolevulinic acid hydrochloride via oral administration (20 mg/kg) 6-8 hours before CV01 treatment.
Anti-tumor activity assessed by Number of cells / mm³ with antibodies against IBA1 and Number of cells / mm³ with antibodies against Caspase III

candidate_flag.reason: 5-ALA is a licensed medicine (Gliolan, visualisation) used as a sonosensitiser with a device; antitumour intent is stated (sonodynamic therapy, anti-tumour activity outcome). Adjudicator to confirm it counts as a pharmacological candidate.

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: Patients With Newly Diagnosed High-Grade Glioma (HGG) Prior to Resection and Standard Adjuvant Therapy

flag.reason: 5-ALA is combined with ultrasound (device, not a drug); coded monotherapy because no other antitumour drug is given in the experimental arm.

role_evidence.quote: Patients will receive sonodynamic therapy (5 ALA combined with CV01-delivered sonication) 2 to 5 days prior to standard resection.

agents.drug_class_hint: porphyrin precursor / sonosensitiser (licensed for GBM fluorescence visualisation)
agents.stated_antitumour_mechanism: sonodynamic therapy: 5-ALA combined with ultrasound sonication

flag.reason: Licensed diagnostic agent used as a sonosensitiser.

coder_notes: Phase 1 single-arm sonodynamic therapy. CV01 ultrasound device is not a drug and is not listed in agents. Population is high-grade glioma with GBM named in conditions and eligibility. Collaborator Alpheus Medical, Inc. is a company named in the sponsor field.
